title: Render label and sheet previews from one scene
description: Render both focused-label and whole-sheet React/SVG previews as adapters over the same authoritative `PrintableScene`, with no duplicate layout calculation or DOM capture.
acceptanceCriteria: Label and sheet previews receive the same scene value for a project revision
Both previews render scene text runs and bounds without recomputing wrapping or placement
The sheet preview places scene content at the assignment's physical sheet position
No preview uses DOM measurement, extracted browser text, screenshots, canvas capture, or a second layout source
Scene diagnostics appear in textual UI associated with the previews

steps.details: Implement thin React/SVG renderers for scene bounds and text runs that consume coordinates and ordering exactly as supplied.
Render one label's scene with a viewBox based on physical label bounds and no presentation-to-domain feedback.
Render sheet boundaries and position the same scene primitives using stable assignment metadata in the sheet's millimetre viewBox.
List scene diagnostics with severity, affected template/position, and corrective text rather than relying on SVG color or marks alone.
Assert both previews expose matching text and scene geometry from one fixture and inspect the code boundary to confirm no alternate wrapping or DOM-capture path exists.

technicalNotes: React owns presentation only; scene layout remains framework-neutral.
SVG viewBox scaling is allowed, but changing viewBox display size must not regenerate scene geometry.
